events.title: Demo Update: Online Multiplayer Fixes & Quality of Life
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who played the Mana Boom demo and sent us feedback! This update focuses on online play, based directly on your reports. Online Multiplayer Fixed a bug where some players couldn't cast any spells for the whole session (ammo and cooldown were used, but nothing came out). This also caused their shots to pass through other players, and stopped them from seeing other players' ropes and explosions.
